Multi-ingredient: Canad.: Digesta. Tilarginine (rINN) BW-546C88; 546C88; L-NMMA; Targinina; Targinine (BAN); Targininum; Tilarginina; Tilargininum. N -Methyl-L-arginine. Таргинин C7H16N4O2 = 188.2. CAS — 17035-90-4. Profile Tilarginine is a nitric oxide synthase inhibitor under investigation in the treatment of cardiogenic shock, although results have been disappointing. It has also been tried in septic shock but appears to have been associated with increased mortality. It has also been investigated in migraine. ◊ References. 1. Lassen LH, et al.
